 Ensure compliance to our approval and risk requirements.
 Grow volume with existing Partners, while getting new Partners ramped up and generating consistent volume.
 3+ years of experience with hands-on direct sales and relationship management.
 1+ years of experience in Home Improvement or consumer lending.
 You must be located in British Columbia.
 Demonstrated expertise in managing successful business-to-business sales and service relationships in an asset.
 You know your way around a CRM, ideally Salesforce.
 Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
 Ability to multitask and meet deadlines under pressure.
 Strong customer service and retail background are pluses.
 Winner of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, twice. We offer more than just the basics, take advantage of:
 An award-winning culture with a collaborative & inclusive team.

 Annual Base Salary: $68,000 - $72,000

 Career learning and development programs.

 As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be on the front lines of our growth efforts. You’ll focus on generating pipeline by identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our Account Executives. You’ll combine a hunter mindset with strong communication skills, creating meaningful connections that turn into sales conversations and future customers.
 This is a foundational role in our sales organization, with clear career growth opportunities.

 Prospect and research target accounts, with a focus on general contractors in the construction industry.
 Conduct high-volume outbound outreach across multiple channels (calls, emails, LinkedIn, video).
 Engage prospects in discovery conversations to uncover needs, pain points, and alignment with Bridgit’s ideal customer profile.
 Qualify opportunities using frameworks like BANT, ensuring leads are sales-ready.
 Book discovery calls and demos for assigned Account Executives.
 Build and maintain relationships with key contacts in target accounts.
 Maintain accurate, up-to-date activity and opportunity records in Salesforce.
 Use Outreach, Apollo, and other RevOps tools to execute and continuously refine prospecting sequences.
 Collaborate closely with Account Executives, meeting weekly to align on strategy and provide feedback on lead quality.
 Share insights with the broader sales team to improve messaging and go-to-market strategy.
 What You Will Bring
 1+ years of experience as a BDR or SDR in a SaaS environment, with consistent quota attainment.
 Demonstrated success driving high activity levels while personalizing outreach.
 Proficiency with modern sales tools: Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach.io, Apollo.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly connect and build rapport.
 A track record of creating pipeline that translates into closed business.
 Resourceful, self-motivated, and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
 Who You Are
 A hunter who thrives on creating new opportunities.
 Results-driven and disciplined in your sales approach.
 Adaptable and coachable, always looking to refine your craft.
 Energetic, resilient, and able to overcome challenges with determination.
 A team player who celebrates wins collectively and learns from losses together.
 What You Will Enjoy 
 A collaborative, autonomous environment where you can make an impact quickly.
 A culture that encourages innovation and professional growth.
 Competitive salary and equity options.
 Unlimited vacation and flexible time off.
 Bridgit Core Values 
 Build Together, Win Together:  Committed to pursuing the best outcomes and advancing toward shared goals. When faced with challenges, they maintain composure and reliability and work as a team.  Proactively remove roadblocks to maintain momentum and achieve goals.  As a team, they embody a solution-oriented attitude and drive to win.
 Take Action, Drive Impact:  Ensure efforts contribute directly to goals.  Step up and offer innovative solutions to overcome obstacles and improve processes.  Leverage the ability to think independently and strategically.  Navigate uncharted territory effectively while also laying a foundation for sustainable growth and success.  
 No Grit, No Pearl: Embrace the gritty aspects of the journey to success.  Pitch in wholeheartedly and recognize that no task is beneath us when it contributes to Bridgit’s collective success.  Believe that confronting ambiguity or adversity with determination, not only strengthens resilience but also fosters growth, driving continuous improvement and achievement.
 Compensation

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Product team 
 The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
 About the role 
 Millions of people use the Affirm Card, but we don’t yet give them a reason to keep coming back beyond the product itself. You’ll build our consumer loyalty program from scratch: what people earn, how they move up, and why Affirm becomes their default way to pay.
 What you’ll do 
 Own the vision and roadmap for Affirm’s consumer loyalty program, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and sequencing across multiple quarters
 Launch the first version of rewards and tiers, including earn mechanics, member benefits, redemption, and the surfaces that make the value obvious in app, at checkout, and after a purchase
 Build the engagement loops (progress, milestones, personalized offers) that turn a one-time borrower into someone who reaches for Affirm every week
 Own the program economics: reward liability, funding mix across merchant-funded offers, interchange and network incentives, and the case for incremental GMV against cost per member
 Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says
 Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people
 Align senior stakeholders and pull together dependencies across Card, Shopping, Servicing and Marketing, leading embedded engineering and design pods through a lot of ambiguity
 What we look for 
 8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks
 Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself
 History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists
 Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them
 Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership
 Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. You know the difference between a reward that feels good and a badge buried in a settings menu
 Deep fluency in experiment design, incrementality/attribution, and LTV measurement; data chops (SQL/Amplitude-level self-serve) and a bias for shipping, learning and iterating quickly
 Track record shipping consumer financial or regulated products; comfort partnering with Risk/Credit, Legal, and Compliance
 Excellent cross-functional leadership, including experience leading without authority
 AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to research, analyze and prototype, and help develop better product vision
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
 Base Pay Grade - P
 Equity Grade - 7
 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
 Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).
 CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - $241,000
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
 Benefits designed for you 
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

The Company 
 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond . We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 
 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 
 This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real. 
 The Role

Reporting to the Manager, Talent Acquisition, this role works independently, applying executive presence, sound judgement, critical thinking, and market insight to partner with senior leaders, including the C-suite, on hiring strategy and to solve complex hiring challenges. The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner also serves as a subject matter expert and informal coach to the team and supports the Manager on Executive and VP searches.
 What You Do 
 Partner with executives and senior leaders to understand current and future hiring needs and shape role requirements, hiring plans, and selection decisions.
 Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for roles across the organization, leading Senior Manager, Director, and other business-critical searches, including confidential searches and select mandates assigned by the Manager, TA.
 Develop and execute proactive sourcing and talent-mapping strategies for senior talent, including passive outreach, networking, and pipelining.
 Deliver a high-quality, high-touch candidate experience for senior candidates.
 Use recruitment metrics and market and compensation intelligence to advise leaders and inform hiring strategy.
 Lead the planning and delivery of talent acquisition initiatives and programs owned by the Manager, TA, managing scope, timelines, stakeholders, and results.
 Apply critical thinking to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and systems.
 Use AI-enabled tools and automation to improve recruiting effectiveness and productivity, with human judgement applied to hiring decisions.
 Support hiring manager training and enablement, including structured interviewing and inclusive hiring practices.
 Act as a subject matter expert and informal coach to the Talent Acquisition team on best practices and complex searches.
 Support the Manager, TA on Executive and VP searches and other select mandates.
 Ensure compliance with employment laws and internal policies related to hiring and candidate data privacy across relevant jurisdictions.
 Perform other related duties as assigned to support team objectives, departmental needs, and overall organizational priorities.
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
 7+ years of progressive experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, including recruiting Senior Manager and Director roles, ideally in a technology or software environment.
 Demonstrated executive presence, with the credibility to advise and influence C-suite and senior leaders.
 Proven success delivering talent acquisition initiatives or programs from planning through implementation, with strong project management and critical thinking skills.
 Experience using AI-enabled recruiting tools and automation to improve efficiency and outcomes, with sound judgement in how they are applied.
 Strong understanding of sourcing techniques, applicant tracking systems (preferably Greenhouse), and recruitment analytics, with the business acumen to apply analytics in advising leaders.
 Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to partner effectively across all levels of the organization.
 A collaborative, adaptable mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and service excellence.
 Note: T his position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 
 Overview
 The Marketing Data Science & Analytics (MDSA) team is Instacart's analytical engine for Paid Media, SEO, and Retailer Marketing — partnering with channel leaders, Finance, and senior marketing leadership to ensure every investment dollar is guided by rigorous, causal measurement. The team owns paid channel analytics, incrementality testing, goal-setting and pacing, LTV-based optimization, and a marketing measurement roadmap anchored on Media Mix Modeling, Experiments, LTV & Touchpoints — Instacart's evolving single source of truth for marketing impact.
 We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Marketing Decision Science team — a group of Decision Scientists embedded across Paid Media, SEO, and Retailer Marketing. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to marketing leadership and regular presence in senior forums including MBRs, SBRs, and Pacing Meetings. This role reports to the Director of Marketing Data Science & Analytics.
 About the Job 
 Lead and develop a team of 5 Decision Scientists and Marketing Analysts, owning their performance, growth, and day-to-day direction — setting and enforcing a high quality bar across all team output
 Own the end-to-end delivery of MDSA's paid marketing analytics workstreams: channel-level goal-setting, pacing, incrementality testing, acquisition and retention analysis, and Retailer Marketing measurement
 Lead the team's contribution to the unified marketing measurement framework - MMM, incrementality testing, LTV, MTA — coordinating MMM inputs, incrementality test organization, and reporting
 Drive re-goaling, rebasing, and scenario modeling exercises that directly inform how Instacart allocates its marketing budget
 Serve as the primary analytical point of contact for senior marketing leadership and Finance — owning those relationships independently and representing MDSA in MBRs, SBRs, and Pacing Meetings
 Define and drive the Marketing Decision Science roadmap in partnership with the Director, translating business priorities into sequenced analytical investments
 Partner with Marketing Data Science on Measurement architecture, LTV modeling, and measurement infrastructure
 Identify opportunities to improve analytical self-serve and reduce recurring reporting burden through tooling and automation
 Build team capacity and coverage plans proactively, including across periods of reduced availability
 Anticipate stakeholder needs and surface proactive insights — not just reactive analysis
 About You 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 8+ years in data science, analytics, or a quantitative function; 3+ years managing teams of analysts or decision scientists
 Deep expertise in paid marketing measurement: incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, attribution, LTV-based optimization, and channel-level performance analytics
 Strong SQL and data fluency; comfort working directly in data to validate and pressure-test team output
 Proven ability to independently own senior cross-functional relationships and represent a data science function in leadership forums without requiring escalation
 Track record of translating complex analyses into clear investment recommendations for non-technical audiences
 Experience managing and developing Decision Scientists or Marketing Analysts with a high bar for quality and direct feedback delivery
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience at a consumer-facing marketplace or high-growth technology company
 Familiarity with geo-experimentation, Bayesian methods, or causal inference frameworks
 Experience with LTV-based media optimization and budget allocation modeling
 Background in building or overhauling channel-level reporting and pacing infrastructure

Are you the kind of person who can walk into a business with no documented contract process and build one from scratch, rather than waiting to be handed a playbook? Do you get energy from making dense legal terms usable for non-legal teams, instead of just filing them away? Are you comfortable owning both sides of a negotiation – redlining what a client sends you and reviewing what a vendor sends us – in the same week?
 If this sounds like you, keep reading. If not, that's okay – this role is not a fit, and that clarity is intentional.
 Why this role exists 
 Contract management at Foundation has been running on multiple people’s tribal knowledge rather than a documented process, and it doesn't scale as our enterprise book (including a recent >$1M account expansion) grows. This role takes full ownership of all contract lifecycles end to end – drafting, negotiating, and reviewing every contract scenario we handle, from new client agreements to vendor and independent contractor agreements – so it's no longer split across whoever has bandwidth that week.
 This person unlocks the next phase of our enterprise growth without adding legal risk or bottlenecking through one overloaded person.
 Who this role is for 
 This role is for someone who:
 Takes ownership of ambiguous, undocumented processes and turns them into a working system
 Is comfortable owning drafting and negotiation directly, not just reviewing what others produce
 Has the judgment to know when to resolve a redline directly and when it needs escalation to counsel
 Communicates contract terms clearly to non-legal stakeholders (sales, AMs, project coordinators)
 Is fluent in modern contract tooling (DocuSign, PandaDoc, ClickUp, AI-assisted knowledge systems) and enjoys configuring it, not just using it
 Adapts well to Foundation's fast-paced, fully remote working rhythm
 This role is not a fit if you: 
 Need a fully built process handed to you before you can start contributing
 Prefer reviewing other people's drafts rather than owning drafting and negotiation yourself
 Are not comfortable working independently across US and Canadian jurisdictions with limited live overlap
 Treat legal review as a bottleneck to route around rather than a judgment call to own
 What you'll be responsible for 
 Full-Cycle Contract Ownership & Negotiation (~75% of your time) 
 You are the single owner of contract drafting and negotiation across every scenario we handle – new client contracts (our template and the client's own paper), change orders, vendor contracts, MNDAs, employment contracts, and independent contractor/freelancer agreements.
 Draft and negotiate new client MSAs/SOWs from our template, and manage the client review and redline process directly
 Own content-mapping and negotiation for contracts using a client's own MSA/SOW template (e.g. enterprise accounts)
 Draft and manage change orders and extension orders referencing standing MSA/T&C terms
 Draft and negotiate vendor contracts, including cross-referencing vendor terms against the live client contract they support, for scope, IP, and confidentiality consistency
 Draft and manage employment, independent contractor and freelancer agreements 
 Own escalation judgment calls – what proceeds internally versus what goes to outside counsel – and act as the sole point of contact with counsel; no other team member initiates contact with outside counsel directly, to protect cost and turnaround time
 Review every contract for insurance and liability terms (indemnification, coverage limits, additional insured requirements) as a standard part of contract review, coordinating with People Ops  to confirm actual coverage specifics and complete InfoSec questionnaires where required – replacing today's ad hoc process
 Audit active SOWs and change orders against governing MSA terms to catch scope creep before it becomes a margin problem
 Improving Contract Knowledge Systems (~25% of your time) 
 Own and harmonize the template library (Client MSA, SOW, Vendor MSA, Change Orders, CA/US Employment contracts, independent and freelance contracts) so terms overlay cleanly across related documents
 Document the accept/reject policy (acceptable terms, deposit requirements, escalation thresholds) that today only exists informally
 Own the contract intake and storage system: manage incoming review/drafting requests through ClickUp triage, and ensure every executed contract is consistently stored in both Google Drive (organized by client) and logged in ClickUp where applicable
 Contribute to an AI-assisted contract knowledge tool build that makes contract terms accessible to account and delivery teams without needing to ask you every time
 Configure and maintain DocuSign/PandaDoc for e-signature, tracking, and lifecycle metadata
 The split will flex depending on where we are in standing up the practice – early months lean more heavily toward the second area. That's expected.
 What success looks like 
 After 90 days:
 Every active contract scenario (new client, client-paper, change order, vendor, independent contractor/freelance, employment, MNDAs) routes through you directly, with no drafting or negotiation left with Sales, AM, People Ops or Project Coordination teams
 The accept/reject policy is documented and being applied consistently
 Template library is harmonized across all contract formats
 Contract intake and dual storage (Google Drive + ClickUp) is live and being used consistently
 A working knowledge system (bot, repository, or summary process) is live for at least one contract category
 Escalation criteria for outside counsel are written down and being followed
 No contract of any type is sitting unreviewed for more than 2 business days
 Qualifications: 
 6+ years in contract management, paralegal, or contracts-counsel work, ideally within B2B SaaS, marketing/agency, or professional services
 Demonstrated experience independently drafting and negotiating MSAs, SOWs, vendor contracts, and change orders – not just reviewing what others draft
 Strong working fluency in US and Canadian contract law fundamentals (indemnification, liability caps, IP/usage rights, data privacy basics). A law license is not required – outside counsel remains engaged for formal legal opinions – but this role needs to know when something requires counsel and be conversant enough to brief them efficiently
 Familiarity with data privacy frameworks relevant to our client base (e.g. GDPR, PIPEDA, CCPA) 
 Proven track record of building a contract management function, workflow, or Customer Lifecycle Management tooling from scratch, not just operating inside an existing one
 Practical fluency with DocuSign, PandaDoc, ClickUp, and at least one AI-assisted knowledge or CLM tool
 Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote, high-volume role, prioritizing across multiple concurrent contract types without close supervision

 Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Technical Architect to lead the Oracle technical layer of the UFS Reimagined program within the Global Finance organization.  Integration Architecture and Oracle Integration Cloud
 • Review the systems integrator's solution design for every in-scope interface and confirm the appropriate Oracle Integration Cloud or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure integration pattern, including orchestration, scheduling, retries, idempotency, and recovery behaviour.

 • Lead the Oracle side of the architecture and security clearances required for Oracle Fusion Cloud to connect to the Kyriba and Sovos cloud platforms, both of which hold Nuvei data on third-party infrastructure and clear on their own merits.
 • Produce the evidence the enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and third-party risk forums require, including context and data-flow diagrams, control assessments, test results, and remediation status.

 • Strong command of Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
 • Practical Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience across identity and access management, compartments, policies, networking, and service limits, sufficient to govern a tenancy rather than only operate in one.

 • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion Cloud with third-party software-as-a-service platforms hosted outside the corporate network, including connectivity, certificate, and identity design.

 • Strong SQL and PL/SQL, together with reporting knowledge across BI Publisher and OTBI, sufficient to review, challenge, and troubleshoot technical objects built by others.
 • Experience transitioning a newly implemented Oracle ecosystem into a managed support model, including hybrid arrangements shared between an internal team and a support partner.

KittySpout / DoggySpout   is looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to join our team! As our creative strategist, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a heavy focus on Meta VSLs, UGC ads, and high-converting direct response ads - short and long form - that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in performance creative, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
Who are we? 
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
What is our culture like & who is a good fit? 
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.
Key Objectives: 
 Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
 Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
 Script Direct response creatives
 Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
 Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
 Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
 Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
 Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative
 Produce a minimum of 15 ad briefs per week , maintaining volume and quality simultaneously — without being chased.
 Fully remote
 Fluent in English
 Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
 Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience interpreting performance data from platforms such as Northbeam, Facebook Ads, leveraging spreadsheets and reporting tools to extract insights, inform strategy and communicate campaign ideas and results.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
 Proven VSL copywriting experience on DR / performance brands
 Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories.
 Meta VSLs: Proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run.
 AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production — not one you tried once.
 Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
 Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands
Examples of What You'll Be Doing: 
 Develop VSL briefings end-to-end: angle, hook, script, structure
 Design AI-driven concepts and hooks for paid video
 Partner with editors and performance marketers on testing
 Iterate strategy based on creative performance data
How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate: 
 We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates in our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has three stages:
(1) Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit. 
(2) Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work. 
(3) Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us. 
KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
 Salary Expectation 
 USD $3,000 - $6,000 per month base (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
 We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.

We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.
 The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.
At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability. 
 Target total compensation ranges from $252,000 - $360,000, including a fixed annual salary of $212,000 - $250,000, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.
 Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.
 Rokt Aftersell helps more than 50,000 Shopify merchants grow revenue across the full Transaction Moment, from the cart through checkout to the post-purchase and Thank You page. Aftersell owns the Aftersell and Upcart apps on the Shopify app store, and was acquired by Rokt in 2024.
 About the role:  
 Rokt Aftersell is looking for a Director of Growth to open up our next sources of revenue. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting directly to the General Manager of Rokt Aftersell, working closely with our go-to-market leaders across marketing, partnerships and sales. 
 This role serves as the product manager for new channels: testing our most promising new revenue channels, segments and products, building a zero-to-one platform to scale them, signing and onboarding the first three customers, then handing each channel to a BD lead or channel owner to scale.
 We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.
 How your future team uses AI:  
 Growth at Rokt Aftersell runs on agentic tools: you will use agents to research markets, build partner and merchant lists, run outreach, launch test experiences and analyze results, so one person can run the experiments that used to need a team. We expect you to be at the forefront, trying new tools as they ship and building your own agents instead of waiting for headcount. AI handles the volume, and you bring the judgment on which bets to make and the relationships with the first customers in each channel.
 How you will contribute:  
 Build and prioritize a portfolio of roughly a dozen new channels, segments and partnerships, such as technology partnerships, affiliate and referral programs, and browser extensions, each sized from first principles.
 Design fast, cheap experiments with success criteria agreed upfront, and make a go or no-go call on each channel in weeks, not quarters.
 Source, pitch, close and onboard the first one to three partners or merchants in each new channel yourself, prototyping the integration, offer or merchant experience with AI tools before working with product, engineering and design to scale it.
 Measure every channel in revenue (pipeline, activity and unit economics), then turn each proven channel into a playbook and hand it to a BD lead or channel owner.
 Partner with marketing, partnerships and sales leaders so new channels add to the core GTM motion, and share the AI-powered research, outreach and analytics workflows you build with the wider GTM team.
 What you bring: 
 7+ years of experience in growth, partnerships, business development, marketing or founder roles, with a track record of taking something from zero to one and tying it to revenue.
 Daily, hands-on use of frontier agentic tools. Claude Code is a given: you’ve experimented with Muse and Instinct out of curiosity, and you’re the first on your team to try new ones every week.
 Strong first-principles thinking: you can break down an unfamiliar market or channel, size it, and design the test that tells you whether it is worth pursuing.
 Commercial instincts: you can sell and negotiate the first deals in a new channel and judge whether its economics will hold at scale.
 An extremely high degree of urgency. You ship this week, learn from it, and ship again.
 A generalist who works independently across teams without formal authority, moves between strategy, selling, building and analysis in the same day, and goes deep on a problem once you understand it.
 Experience in the Shopify or ecommerce SaaS ecosystem, building a technology partnership, affiliate or referral program from scratch, or as a founder or first go-to-market hire would be great.

 We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

 Trauma-Informed Principles

 Relationship-Centered Approach

 Lead integrated programs and services . Job Purpose 
 Build a profitable rental portfolio through established industry relationships, proactive business development, and consistent client service. Rental Reps develop trusted, long-term partnerships with lighting designers, production managers, and other industry decisionmakers, turning those relationships into repeat rental business.
 Responsibilities 
 Builds strategic client relationships.
 Generates new business and grows client portfolio.
 Influences product specification.
 Sets goals and monitors portfolio performance.
 Partners with Project Management to ensure high-quality job execution.
 Supports CL policies, procedures, and business model.
 Works independently with support from VP Rentals.
 1. Builds strategic client relationships by: 
 Developing business through an established network within stage lighting, live entertainment, or related production markets.
 Proactively arranging in-person meetings, regular check-ins, and job-site visits.
 Building relationships with lighting designers, production managers, producers, and other decision-makers who influence rental selections.
 Understanding client needs and maintaining trust through responsive communication, problem-solving, and follow-through.
 Traveling regularly to meet clients and support relationships in their working environment.
 2. Generates new business and grows client portfolio by: 
 Converting industry connections and referrals into rental opportunities.
 Actively expanding an industry network through introductions, outreach, client meetings, and industry events.
 Identifying upcoming productions and engaging decision-makers early in the planning process.
 Pursuing new clients while increasing repeat business within existing accounts.
 Negotiating rental opportunities and closing business with long-term relationship value in mind.
 3. Influences product specification by: 
 Developing a strong technical understanding of Christie Lites’ rental equipment and Official Rental Product Line.
 Working with lighting designers and specifiers to have Christie Lites products requested at bid time.
 Recommending effective Christie Lites substitutions when competing equipment is specified.
 4. Sets goals and monitors portfolio performance by: 
 Establishing annual client relationship and financial targets with VP Rentals.
 Maintaining a proactive plan to achieve revenue and portfolio growth goals.
 Reviewing commission reports, account performance, and profitability with management.
 Identifying barriers to growth and taking action to improve results.
 Reviewing show reports and client feedback to address service and execution issues.
 Reviewing client assignments with management to support long-term portfolio success.
 5. Partners with Project Management to ensure high-quality job execution by: 
 Providing timely, accurate client and production information for quotes, reservations, and orders.
 Ensuring rental requirements and changes are communicated before, during, and after each job.
 Working with Project Management and Operations to resolve issues affecting client satisfaction.
 Supporting Accounting with timely invoicing and collection of accounts.
 6. Supports CL policies, procedures, and business model by: 
 Promoting the Official Rental Product Line.
 Following the One Contact–One Rep client management policy.
 Meeting accounting and administrative deadlines and maintaining accurate account information.
 Coordinating with the appropriate departments for project, operational, and administrative support.
 7. Works independently with support from VP Rentals by: 
 Taking ownership of client relationships, business development activity, and established goals.
 Maintaining consistent, proactive daily business practices.
 Managing time effectively across prospecting, client meetings, travel, and account follow-up.
 Communicating opportunities, challenges, and strategies with VP Rentals and the National Rentals Manager.
 Seeking support from management and other departments when needed.
 Essential personal attributes for success in this role: 
 Relationship-oriented, with the ability to earn trust and maintain long-term connections.
 Competitive, ambitious, and motivated by results and earning potential.
 Self-directed and proactive in pursuing opportunities.
 Decisive and comfortable negotiating and closing business.
 Attentive to details, especially financial commitments, and client requirements.
 Willing to travel regularly and work around client and production schedules.
 Essential professional attributes for success in this role: 
 An established network of relevant entertainment and production industry contacts.
 Multiple years of experience in stage lighting, live entertainment, or related production areas.
 Demonstrated ability to turn relationships into business opportunities.
 A record of success developing accounts, securing business, or influencing rental decisions.
 Strong negotiation skills and sound commercial judgment.
 Technical knowledge of entertainment lighting equipment, or the ability to develop it quickly.
 Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to work effectively with an international team of support staff.
 Additional Information 
 Christie Lites operates one of the largest stage lighting rental companies in North America, with locations across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. For over 35 years, the company has supported clients across trade shows, corporate and special events, film and television, concert and theatrical touring, education, and the arts.
 Christie Lites Rental Reps serve clients through an individual relationship model. Client assignments are based on relationships rather than geographic territories or market sectors, allowing broad opportunities for portfolio growth.
 This role combines independent business development with support from Project Management, Operations, Accounting, and management. Success requires an established industry network, continued prospecting, regular client contact, and ownership of the client relationship from initial opportunity through successful rental execution.
